events.text:
Thank you, Hannah. You're verified.

I've checked order O-5107 from Saffron Lane (Paneer butter masala and Jeera rice, total $27.22). Unfortunately, I can't change its delivery address. The order was picked up at 7:24 PM, and addresses can only be changed before pickup, while the order is still being prepared. For the same reason, I can't cancel it.

The order is still scheduled for 81 Ridge Rd, so I'm sorry, but I'm not able to redirect it from here. Your default address on the account is still 6 Willow Lane, so I'd recommend updating that now so future orders go to the right place.

If you'd like help with anything else on this order, let me know.

Oh no, I really didn't want this to happen. Is there absolutely nothing that can be done? The driver is probably already on the way to my old place, and I don't want the food to go to someone else or get wasted.

Could I at least cancel it and get my money back? I know it's my mistake, but $27.22 is a lot to lose on something I can't eat.

I'm sorry, Hannah. I know this is frustrating. I can't cancel the order or refund the $27.22, because orders that have already been picked up can't be cancelled, and I can only refund an order in those cases if something was missing or wrong when it arrived. Nothing I can do from here will redirect the order or stop the driver.

Here's what you could try right now:

- **Contact the restaurant, Saffron Lane.** They can tell you the order was picked up and may be able to help you reach the driver.
- **Look for a driver contact in the Forkful app** on the order screen, if one is shown, so you can ask them to take the food to a different address or hold it.

If the food does arrive at 81 Ridge Rd and you're missing anything, or something is wrong with it, please report it within 48 hours of delivery and I'll review what we can do under our policy.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

Okay, I understand. I'll try contacting Saffron Lane and checking the app for the driver's number. Thank you for checking on it for me.

I'm sorry for the trouble, I really should have double-checked the address before ordering. I'll update my account address right away.

You're welcome, Hannah. Please don't worry about the trouble. Moving is hectic, and it's an easy thing to miss.

Updating your account address is a good idea. I hope you get the order sorted out, and enjoy your new place!
